seeds: development seeds 0-31, each red then blue as poison (64 lives), 100 s; all-food one life per seed per poison label (64; red/blue labels give two worlds per seed as in D176)

substrates.silicon: mixed_feedback SUBSTRATES['silicon'] via Circuit(substrate=...) only; VOLT 1 V, on_chip False: noise-only diagnostic, not an on-chip implementation

circuit: brains/designed.py DesignedBrain unmodified, via lab adapter brain.make_brain; D176 repairs: P memory nodes, taste writers' thresholds +-0.8 V

arms.informed: Life(learning=False); food knob 1.0, poison knob 0.0 at birth (PRIVILEGED: wiring and valence)

metrics.primary: (food-poison) per 10 s in the fixed final third of the 100 s life (ticks 6667-9999), all lives
metrics.secondary: D176's: last third of time after moving began
metrics.separate: food and poison counts and rates; stranding (no meal in life) Wilson 95%; knob order/strong state (>=0.8/<=0.2) end/ever/lost; path length; motor/sensor spike rates
metrics.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over seeds (seed mean of red/blue lives), 4000 resamples, rng 178, 95% percentile
metrics.job_limits: food rate lower bound >= 1/10 s; pooled food:poison >= 3; stranding Wilson upper <= 5%

stage1_branch: stop historical branch only if informed AND learning silicon pass all job limits AND learning silicon - learning biology lower bound > +0.10; else stage 2
commands: python lab/robot_action_20261120/checks.py  (R1; also produces the biology stage-1 captures)
